description:
Take a break from the daily hustle and bustle, enjoying exciting adventures with improved graphics and more detailed locations!
Spend unforgettable moments away from urban bustle, going hiking, horseback riding and boating. 
Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete mini-games.

The collector's edition includes:
- 12 additional levels with hidden object and mini-games 
- 8 additional mini-games
- Souvenir shop with various trophies.
name: Amazing Weekend Search and Relax Collector's Edition
intro: Perfect journey for those who look for inspiration and adventure.
